statement: This sketch depicts a continuously knitting sweater emerging from the bottom of the canvas. As the fabric grows upward, it displays alternating horizontal stripes in earthy browns and tans, reminiscent of traditional knitted patterns. Scattered throughout this evolving surface are intricate decorative stitches that appear to knit themselves into existence. Each stitch is rendered as an interlocking geometric loop, with each loop animated through rotation and subtle pulsing motion, creating the illusion of being hand-crafted in real time. The animation gives a rhythmic, organic quality to the process, simulating the continuous motion of a knitter's hands working on a growing piece of fabric. The viewer witnesses a self-sustaining creative process where new stitches are continuously added while old ones are removed, maintaining a constant flow of structured, colorful geometry that fills the canvas.
